name: Virelle
summary: Virelle is crafted in a choice of fabric or imitation leather, each finish creating a distinct mood of elegance. Its fully upholstered form gives it a sculptural presence, while seamless lines and tailored detailing highlight an attentive craft. With quiet confidence and timeless character, it brings warmth and distinction to contemporary living. 62x52x88
